keyword.armor_break.name: Armor Break
keyword.armor_break.tooltip: Reduces defense and makes follow-up hits more effective.
keyword.bleed.name: Bleed
keyword.bleed.tooltip: A damage-over-time effect that keeps ticking until it expires.
keyword.burn.name: Burn
keyword.burn.tooltip: Fire damage over time that refreshes rather than stacking into a separate rule path.
keyword.freeze.name: Freeze
keyword.freeze.tooltip: Cold control that locks the target down until the effect ends or is overwritten.
keyword.stun.name: Stun
keyword.stun.tooltip: Prevents the target from acting for the listed duration.
keyword.shield.name: Shield
keyword.shield.tooltip: A defensive effect that increases survivability without changing core HP semantics.
keyword.penetration.name: Penetration
keyword.penetration.tooltip: Pushes damage through mitigation more reliably.
keyword.diminishing_returns.name: Diminishing Returns
keyword.diminishing_returns.tooltip: Repeated control or stacking effects lose value if you try to loop them endlessly.
keyword.power_save.name: Power Save
keyword.power_save.tooltip: Uses the talent's power dimension when the target gets a resistance save.
keyword.telegraph.name: Telegraph
keyword.telegraph.tooltip: A preview that exposes an upcoming hostile action before it resolves.
keyword.crit.name: Critical
keyword.crit.tooltip: A high-roll hit that amplifies the final damage result.
keyword.dot.name: Damage Over Time
keyword.dot.tooltip: Keeps dealing damage across future turns instead of only on cast.
keyword.sustain.name: Sustain
keyword.sustain.tooltip: A longer-running talent pattern that trades burst for persistent value.
keyword.cleanse.name: Cleanse
keyword.cleanse.tooltip: Removes negative effects without rewriting the source status contract.
keyword.dispel.name: Dispel
keyword.dispel.tooltip: Strips an effect off a target through the status engine's normal rules.
keyword.damage.name: Damage
keyword.damage.tooltip: Directly lowers the target's HP through the combat pipeline.
keyword.movement.name: Movement
keyword.movement.tooltip: Changes position as part of the talent's resolved effect.
keyword.single_target.name: Single Target
keyword.single_target.tooltip: Affects one primary target rather than an area.
keyword.area.name: Area
keyword.area.tooltip: Affects multiple tiles or targets in a radius or pattern.
keyword.buff.name: Buff
keyword.buff.tooltip: Improves the acting unit with a positive timed effect.
keyword.cleave.name: Cleave
keyword.cleave.tooltip: Hits multiple nearby enemies off one action.
keyword.control.name: Control
keyword.control.tooltip: Limits enemy actions, movement, or effective response windows.
keyword.curse.name: Curse
keyword.curse.tooltip: A persistent debuff that drags down offense or defense.
keyword.debuff.name: Debuff
keyword.debuff.tooltip: Applies a negative state to weaken the target.
keyword.defense.name: Defense
keyword.defense.tooltip: Improves mitigation or staying power rather than raw output.
keyword.finisher.name: Finisher
keyword.finisher.tooltip: A payoff talent that becomes stronger once setup or target state is favorable.
keyword.heal.name: Heal
keyword.heal.tooltip: Restores lost HP through the healing pipeline.
keyword.holy.name: Holy
keyword.holy.tooltip: Uses the holy damage channel and related interactions.
keyword.knockback.name: Knockback
keyword.knockback.tooltip: Pushes the target away if space allows.
keyword.mobility.name: Mobility
keyword.mobility.tooltip: Creates or denies distance as part of the action.
keyword.panic.name: Panic
keyword.panic.tooltip: An emergency stabilizer meant for bad turns or low margin states.
keyword.ranged.name: Ranged
keyword.ranged.tooltip: Can be used beyond adjacent melee distance.
keyword.reposition.name: Reposition
keyword.reposition.tooltip: Moves the actor to a more favorable tile without changing core movement rules.
keyword.resource.name: Resource
keyword.resource.tooltip: Consumes or restores a tracked profession resource.
keyword.slow.name: Slow
keyword.slow.tooltip: Reduces pace, initiative, or practical threat windows.
